messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "ask doctor before using muscle relaxer"
set: ["ask doctor before using muscle relaxer", "ask doctor before using sleeping pill", "ask doctor before using opioid medication", "ask doctor before stopping", "ask doctor before using medicine for anxiety or seizures", "ask doctor before taking NSAID", "ask your doctor before stopping the medicine", "ask your doctor how to stop using safely", "ask doctor before changing dose or medication schedule", "ask your doctor before changing your medication dosage", "ask doctor if safe to breastfeed while using medicine", "ask your doctor about using a non-hormonal birth control", "ask your doctor about prostate cancer screening before starting", "ask a doctor or pharmacist before using medicines for pain, fever, swelling, or cold/flu symptoms", "ask a doctor if it is safe to breastfeed while using this medicine", "ask your doctor about any risk"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
